About Me

I teach computer science at The Latin School of Chicago. One thing I love about teaching is that you’re guaranteed a laugh every day. I am completing my MBA in Educational Leadership at MSOE. I have many ideas for improving education that I want to bring to fruition. I volunteer. I believe progress comes from direct action. I’d value speaking with you — about educational change strategies or just golf and movies!
